title: connectors.calendar_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the connectors module, in the transaction that moves a calendar stream's cursor, with one batch of changes to one provider calendar. Ids and a blob reference only: the calendar's provider id and the events are in the calendar-change-batch v1 blob. Workspace-scoped.

connection.description: The connection (an id of the connectors module).

batch.description: The calendar-change-batch v1 document, a blob of the workspace.
